sections.body: Write a program that reads a distance D, computes a slab score, adds a 50-point bonus, and prints the total.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It scores 2 per unit to 40, 4 per unit to 60, 6 per unit to 120 and 8 beyond, then adds 50.
